doc.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
doc.interviewee: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor

title: A touring band for Handy and Taylor's first record with Joe Rule
summary: The interviewer asks about a short-lived touring band and its members; Taylor cannot remember them, only that he made the first record.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: A band that, uh, Jolly got together for a tour. And, uh, it had been a band that belonged to a man by the name of Eldin or Eldridge or something like that. Do you remember anything about such a band? It would be in the, maybe in the late 20s. No, 26, 22. What's going on?
I know him in the handy, if I was to have a band together.
Isn't that long? A couple of weeks?
No, no. Only a few days, didn't sell out.
Yeah. Who was in that handy, uh, John Lowe band? Any idea? I don't know.
I really don't know. You said I made the first record with him, Joe Rule. I don't remember the last record with him.
You made the first record with Joe Rule. Yeah, I made the first record. Who else was in that bandit?
Oh, I can't remember. It was just a record date.
He's gonna sit as one of the men.
